question: To whom and from what motive was this teaching of Dakṣiṇā Kālī spoken?
premises: The teaching is declared as spoken.
It was addressed to the beautiful one out of loving union.
inference: This teaching of Dakṣiṇā Kālī was lovingly communicated to the beautiful addressee.
plain_english: This teaching of Dakṣiṇā Kālī was spoken to the beautiful one out of love.
